sections.text:
Increases critical hit damage of all allies by 20% for 50 seconds and heals all allies for 6% of their maximum HP every 5 seconds for 50 seconds.
Added effect: Removes status ailments from all allies and increases your maximum HP by 30% for 60 seconds.
Level bonus: Heal effect boosted by 1% for each increase in Skill level.
